title: Collard Greens with White Beans
description: This quick and easy low-fat beans and collard greens vegan dish is made with onion, garlic, and canned tomatoes for a boost of flavor.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons water, or more as needed
salt and ground black pepper to taste
1 (14.5 ounce) can great Northern beans, rinsed and drained

steps.text: Heat 2 tablespoons water in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir onion and garlic in water until onion is softened and translucent, about 10 minutes; add more water as needed to prevent scorching. Stir vegetarian bouillon into onion mixture until incorporated.
Stir tomatoes, 1 1/4 cups water, and collard greens into onion mixture. Season with salt and pepper; cover and simmer until vegetables are tender, about 20 minutes.
Stir in beans and sugar and continue to simmer until liquid evaporates, about 10 minutes more. Adjust seasoning as needed.
